args.name: small-soil-patch-preparation
args.function: Physically prepare one small reachable vegetated footprint as exposed bare soil suitable for a subsequent root-placement attempt, if feasible under actual local conditions. Examine feasibility before disturbing the surface and report failures honestly.
args.conditions: The examined footprint at x=9.25,y=12.9 is vegetated forest floor with no observed occupants. Root-planting-trial revision 1 accepts exposed bare soil only; ordinary-soil moisture regime alone is insufficient. Do not disturb occupied or reserved surfaces. Personal learning and actual work must precede effects.
args.inputs: A nominated reachable footprint of radius 0.2; actual tools or materials only if required and available. No tools are assumed owned.
args.costs: Unknown; specify feasible method, energy, work duration, required tools, and interruption or cancellation behavior before execution. Bound disturbance to the nominated footprint.
args.effects: Only actual surface preparation and dated evidence of resulting clearance or limitations. Do not grant roots, deeper substrate knowledge, fertility, propagation, harvest, happiness, or automatic planting.

candidates.function: Record a planted-root baseline, observe, or physically uncover and cover an existing specimen while retaining actual progress and private evidence.
candidates.costs: Begin/observe: one round and 0.2 energy. Inspect: two paid work rounds, one energy each, no consumed root or tools. Only the creator may handle a plot; anyone may observe reachable public state. Provide target plot ID; resume/cancel can use exact personal processId.
candidates.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. Interruption retains exposure and paid work; resume completes outstanding work only. Cancel/death releases the lock without automatically covering or refunding effort. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended. Repeated unchanged observations and the 30-round checkpoint create no reward. No inferred germination, tending benefit, harvested food or biomass is supplied. Relevant dated physical changes may use the single existing grounded-understanding rule. Records remain personal until actual communication.

candidates.function: Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Completed plots retain the real reserved root while existing environmental ageing runs. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. Other people can observe the actual plot; execution requires personal study.
